name: flaggems_max_unpool2d
description: Extracted from FlagGems max_unpool2d. Places pooled values back into a zero output tensor at the flattened positions given by MaxPool2d indices; output_size is the [H, W] spatial size. Indices must be built with the standard CPU flattened int64 layout (the NPU MaxPool2d index format is opaque and incompatible), and the NPU aten.max_unpool2d op does not support bfloat16.
